cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 88% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.38% · WTI +1.17% · Brent +1.39% · NatGas +2.40%. 88% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +5.61%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.61%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.16%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.80%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.80%, OKLO +7.57%, PWR +6.32%, VRT +6.15%, GEV +6.02%. Laggards: NEE -0.67%, ETR -0.56%, MPLX -0.19%.
